Flow.description: This flow handles assigning the default letter template to the opportunity when a donation is closed won.

formulas.name: TotalAmountText
formulas.expression: IF( ABS({!$Record.Amount}) >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Amount} / 1000)) & "," & RIGHT("000" & TEXT(MOD(ABS({!$Record.Amount}), 1000)), 3), TEXT({!$Record.Amount}) )

Flow.label: Opportunity (Before Insert/Update --> Merge Acknowledgment Letter)

textTemplates.name: Tier1_Major_Donors_10000
textTemplates.text:
Thank you for your incredibly generous gift. Your contribution of ${!TotalAmountText} will be instrumental in advancing our mission at {!$Organization.Name}.


Thanks to your support, we will be able to provide 500 meals to families in need, fund scholarships for 10 students, and expand our community outreach programs. Your commitment to making a difference inspires us every day, and we are honored to have you as a partner in this work.


We would love the opportunity to personally express our appreciation and share our vision for the year ahead. Please let us know if we can schedule a time to connect.


Thank you for your continued belief in our mission. Your generosity is changing lives, and we are deeply grateful.


With heartfelt appreciation,

textTemplates.name: Tier2_Leadership_Donors_5000_9999
textTemplates.text:
Your generous gift will make a meaningful impact at {!$Organization.Name}. With your support totaling ${!TotalAmountText}, we will be able to expand our educational programs, and help more families in crisis.


Your commitment to our mission has helped drive real change, and we want to take a moment to say thank you. Your support means more than just numbers—it means hope, opportunity, and transformation for those we serve.


We look forward to continuing this journey with you in the years to come and hope you’ll join us for upcoming events and updates.


Thank you for being such an important part of our community.


With gratitude,

textTemplates.name: Tier3_Sustaining_Donors_1000_4999
textTemplates.text:
We are so grateful for your support! Your generous contribution of ${!TotalAmountText} will help us offer after-school programs for children.


Because of donors like you, {!$Organization.Name} continues to make a meaningful impact in our community. Every dollar you give strengthens our ability to serve and support those who need it most.


Thank you for being a vital part of our mission. We hope to keep you updated on the difference you are making and invite you to continue this journey with us.


With appreciation,

textTemplates.name: Tier4_Dedicated_Supporters_250_999
textTemplates.text:
Your generosity will help us move our mission forward, and we are truly grateful. With your contribution totaling ${!TotalAmountText}, we will be able to provide warm meals to those in need.


Every gift, no matter the size, makes a difference in the lives of those we serve. Your kindness and generosity remind us that together, we can create positive change.


Thank you for being part of our community and for making a difference. We hope you’ll continue to support our work in the future!


With warm appreciation,

textTemplates.name: Tier5_FirstTime_or_Occasional_Donors_Under_250
textTemplates.text:
We are so grateful for your support of {!$Organization.Name}! Your gift of ${!TotalAmountText} will help us offer food assistance to families.


Your generosity, along with that of other caring supporters, helps us continue our mission. We invite you to stay connected with us and see the incredible work you’re making possible.


Thank you for believing in our mission and for being part of the change. We hope you’ll continue to support us in the future!


With gratitude,
